I know there have been a few proposals for a place for shibes to gather that is outside of reddit, or at least as a failsafe in case this wonderful community becomes inaccessible (either temporarily or permanently), and how shibes could continue our community in case any of this happened. However, I haven't seen a proposal that puts shibes closer to dogecoin.

I was reading about alternative chains on the bitcoin wiki, and about how merged mining works in general. My idea is to use a separate blockchain that shares work with dogecoin, and can thus be merge-mined. This should protect the fledgling network from some types of attacks, and will secure the network for the foreseeable future. This new blockchain should contain a history of voting and comment posts.

Instead of this blockchain issuing tokens, each address that is associated would be able to submit a value to the table that is kept for each wallet. Wallets would be associated with Users, Posts, and Comments. Each wallet holds a single table that records the incoming address and the message. The message would contain our voting system, new Tx simply update the value on the table so users would not be able to double-vote. This means that alts (and spam accounts) would still be possible.

So, to fight this Transactions on our voting/comment chain would pay a mining fee. This mining fee would be taken from the Dogecoin address that is associated with the personal wallet on the community blockchain. Thus, to submit or vote requires a trivial dollar amount for users, and ensures miners will want to process our alternative chain.

This could all be structured in such a way that the voting system is all that is on one chain and could be used to drop in a voting solution to any site, and the historical data of the doge community across a variety of sites would be preserved, and our community would be resilient against any centralized server from going down.

TL;DR: Why not create a voting system that uses an alternative chain, includes transaction fees, and is merge-mined with Doge?
What about leveraging blockchain technology to preserve our community?
